notes.title: Xilost - Current state of the game.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Everyone![/h1]

Sorry that we have been under the surface for a long time. We now gradly to announce that now we are full-time working on this project. We just finished our game play prototype and would like to show some updates. Many things may seem out of place and a bit odd. But we promise to do our best to make this game enjoyable and provides a unique game experience to everyone.

This video below will show game gunplay PVP before adding enemy NPCs to the game. The overall result meets our expectations. As we had mentioned, Project Xilost will be a PVE co-op 4 player. Right now we decided to create a simple PVP mode to test on the overall system. We will also make a DEV log for further details for our project. 

Don't forget to follow us on this journey on social media. We will do our best to keep you updated about the game and looking forward to hear your feedback and suggestions. We want to thank everyone who is still waiting for our project and for all support.

Xilost Team.
